note: mapping_basis=data_labels, no inference in the code->text tie: data/goldberg_2018_escs.py melts SDV.tab with var_name="item" and renames nothing (the 75 single-column adjective families are pooled into the "adjectives" block by _blocks), so the live codes ARE the .tab column names (core model s3 pattern 1). Those names are 8-character SPSS truncations of the adjective itself (Absent_m, Overcons, Self_dis ...), so the codes are also self-describing; the DDI <labl level="variable"> for each of the 75 carries the full adjective, and every code is the 8-char prefix of its label (hyphen->underscore) for 75/75. Three-way check, 75/75 in the same order: .tab header cols 165-239 = DDI labels = SDV_items.txt list = SDV.pdf p.7 read column-wise (Assured..Vivacious, Absent-minded..Vindictive, Accommodating..Zestful). Corroborated against the live data although not required: DDI sumStat mean per variable reproduces the per-item mean of irw_fetch() to max abs diff 1.8e-15 over 75/75 items (699 ids, 52011 rows). text_source=study_materials: item_text, instructions and option_text are transcribed from SDV.pdf page 7, the administered form. Deviations, all disclosed: (1) Overcons -- DDI label and SDV_items.txt both read "Overconsciencious"; the printed form reads "Overconscientious" and that ships. (2) DDI label "Spirited " has a trailing space, stripped. (3) option_text is composed from the form's two-level scale header: each point carries its own word (Very / Moderately / Slightly, and "Uncertain, Neutral, or Don't know word" for the midpoint) under a group heading "NOT CHARACTERISTIC / Not typical of me" (points 1-3) or "CHARACTERISTIC / Typical of me" (5-7); option_text joins the point word to its group heading as "<word> <HEADING> (<subheading>)", casing as printed. (4) The midpoint bubble is printed as "?" not "4"; the deposit carries no value labels, and the data store 4 for it (all 7 levels 1-7 occur; the form bubbles run 1 2 3 ? 5 6 7), so resp=4 is the "?" point by position. Meddleso has no resp=7 response in the live data (max 6); its 7 option row is kept because the option was offered. The dotted leaders after each adjective on the form are layout, not text, and were dropped. The heading "HOW ACCURATELY CAN YOU DESCRIBE YOURSELF?" is carried in instrument, not instructions. Rights: deposit CC0 1.0; the instrument is Goldberg's own adjective rating form, published in full by the depositing author; no fee, permission, non-commercial, no-derivatives or no-redistribution clause located on the deposit (silence, not a positive grant; register has no SDV/adjective row and none is written here).
